name: Cognitive Maze v2.5.2 - Term Bridge Isolation Prevention & Multi-Assessment Progression
notes: Version 2.5.2: Prevents question NPCs from spawning across unbuilt bridges in Term 1 and Term 3 (map8 aqueduct) via spatial bounds exclusion and connected-component flood-fill verification; enforces multi-assessment completion before unlocking subsequent terms; eliminates startup indentation issue and surface bit-depth anomalies while strictly maintaining 60 FPS performance on AMD A4-6300 dual-core target hardware.
